display_name: Fusil de tireur d'élite à verrou

clips.description: drawn from below the view, both hands find the grip and the fore-end, a settle
breathing (frame 0 = the hip pose the game measures: HipGripLocation / HipRotation)
carried low and canted across the body, marked bob
hip -> eye at the eyepiece of the scope (socket_scope_eye on the camera axis), small settle
eye at the scope, light breathing (frame 0 = the aim pose the game measures: AimMuzzleLocation / AimRotation)
shot from the hip: sharp kick (muzzle up, back, roll) and settle; the bolt stays closed (BoltCycle follows)
shot through the scope: the kick, then the eye comes back to the eyepiece

right hand to the knob, bolt lifted (BoltOpen), pulled back (CaseEject: the spent case leaves socket_eject toward socket_eject_dir), pushed forward, turned down (BoltClose: a round chambered), hand back to the grip

bolt opened, a stripper clip of five from the pouch seated in the charger guide (ClipIn), the rounds thumbed down into the magazine (RoundsIn: five rounds), the bolt pushed home kicks the empty clip out (ClipEject), turned down (BoltClose: a round chambered)
the trigger falls on an empty chamber (DryClick)
the scope raised to the eye, then the rifle rolled to show the bolt and the action
empty: the bolt flicked open on the empty magazine (Empty), a look, thrown to the right and down (Release); the weapon clip goes on falling after Release (the game drops the pickup there)

moving_parts.bolt: turn-bolt: rotates up to 60 deg about the bore axis (BoltOpen), slides back 7.5 cm (CaseEject at the rear), forward, turned down (BoltClose); carries the handle, the knob (socket_bolt_knob) and the cocking piece
moving_parts.trigger: pivots back 15 deg at Fire / DryClick
moving_parts.stripper_clip: the steel strip of the clip; hidden (scale 0) outside Reload; Reload: from the pouch to the guide (ClipIn), kicked out by the bolt (ClipEject), flies up and right, hidden once out of view
moving_parts.clip_rounds: the five rounds as one rigid column; Reload: in the clip, thumbed down by PUSH_DEPTH into the magazine (RoundsIn); every other clip shows them in the magazine (the top round under the open bolt)

scope.offset: left of the bore (+Y): the stripper clip loads from the top, the bolt handle lifts on the right

bolt.lift_axis: weapon X through the bore axis, the handle rises (rotation -lift about +X)

magazine.clip: stripper clip of five, seated in the charger guide at x = 0.0855 m

rules.bAllowAiming: true (scope); the aim clips put socket_scope_eye on the camera axis, see fp_framing.aim_*
rules.ShellEject: SM_BoltRifle_Casing at CaseEject from socket_eject toward socket_eject_dir

notes: Bolt-action sniper rifle, late 19th century in the spirit of the Lee-Metford / Mauser (fictional): walnut stock, blued steel, 60 deg bolt lift, five round magazine loaded from a stripper clip, long brass scope offset to the left.

Aim: AimIn / AimIdle / AimFire / AimOut are authored with the eye ON THE SCOPE AXIS, EYE_RELIEF behind the eyepiece (socket_scope_eye on the first person camera axis); fp_framing.aim_* reproduces that camera (zero offset in the game).
The lenses are a separate material slot (M_BoltRifle_Lens, not baked): swap it for a scope render material if wanted.
BoltCycle is a new gesture (EFirearmGesture::BoltCycle to add): Fire then BoltCycle chambers the next round.
Events of Reload: BoltOpen, ClipIn, RoundsIn (count the five rounds here), ClipEject, BoltClose (a round chambered).

coordinate_system.blender: +X weapon forward, +Z up, -Y right side; the bean looks along -Y, its right side is -X
coordinate_system.unreal: convert_scene + convert_scene_unit, import scale 1; a weapon point (x, y, z) m -> (x, -y, z) * 100 cm

scope.note: AimIdle frame 0 has the eye (socket_scope_eye) exactly on the camera and the scope axis along the view: the eyepiece is centred on the crosshair 8 cm ahead (beyond the 5 cm near plane). AimFieldOfView 55 is a proposal (the eyepiece fills half the view); a narrower one (zoom) needs a scope overlay or a render material on M_BoltRifle_Lens, otherwise the dark lens fills the screen.

fp_framing.note: HipGripLocation / HipRotation reproduce this camera exactly (Idle frame 0 = hip pose). AimMuzzleLocation / AimRotation (aim_*) reproduce the authored aim (AimIdle frame 0): eye on the scope axis. Copy them into DA_BoltRifleRules (and bAllowAiming true for the scope).

bolt_sequence.note: Fire (or AimFire) then BoltCycle; CaseEject: spawn SM_BoltRifle_Casing at socket_eject toward socket_eject_dir

reload_sequence.note: RoundsIn adds the five rounds of the clip; ClipEject: the strip is kicked out (bone hidden 8 frames later; SM_BoltRifle_EmptyClip for a physical one); BoltClose chambers a round

unreal_import.actor_attachment: Both Bean and weapon actor roots use the same world transform; do not attach the weapon to the hand a second time.
unreal_import.textures: manifest.materials[M_*].textures by label: BaseColor (sRGB), Normal (DirectX, green down), ORM (AO / roughness / metallic, linear); a material without textures (lenses) keeps the material of the FBX import
unreal_import.statics: exports/Static/*.fbx: pivot bottom centre, UCX hulls in the file (import with collision from the file)
